subject: Access preflight: SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist / service-account naming — Peregrine Financial
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Martin Hall <martin.hall@peregrinefin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Access preflight: SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist / service-account naming — Peregrine Financial

Martin —

Thanks for the great kickoff earlier. Before we schedule the technical cutover, we want to run a short preflight so our implementation sprint hits the SLA targets and avoids last-minute blockers. Goal: one-hour preflight with your IT/Security and our implementation engineers to lock entity IDs, SCIM mappings, IP CIDRs, and service-account patterns.

Ask: could you confirm the following items ahead of the call so we can come prepared?

- Primary SSO connection: the IdP Entity ID(s) you plan to use and whether you’ll provide metadata URL or signed XML.
- SCIM user attributes: which attributes you map for org_role, department, manager, and external_id (we typically expect email, given_name, family_name, title). If you have a current mapping CSV, please attach.
- IP allowlist: CIDRs for outbound app-to-app callbacks (our webhook IPs) and any egress filters on your side we should be aware of.
- Service accounts: naming convention and whether Peregrine requires per-environment service accounts (e.g., redwood-pf-prod-svc) or a single shared account for the integration.
- Org policies: any restrictions for SCIM provisioning (e.g., restrict group creation, require admin approval for invite) and any required attribute validation rules.

If you can drop the SCIM mapping CSV and the IdP metadata before EOD Monday PST, Monica and Ben will draft the implementation checklist and we’ll propose a 60-min preflight time slot.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks — look forward to locking this down.

—
Dylan Brooks
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
+d: (415) 555-0128
From: Martin Hall <martin.hall@peregrinefin.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security+it@peregrinefin.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access preflight: SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist / service-account naming — Peregrine Financial

Dylan —

Thanks, sounds good. Quick answers below and I attached the SCIM mapping CSV and our IdP metadata PDF.

- IdP: We’ll use our primary Okta tenant; I attached the metadata (peregrine-sso-entity-ids.pdf). We can also share a metadata URL if you prefer — let us know which you want.
- SCIM: Attached CSV shows our current attribute map. We map manager as 'managerEmail' and external_id is 'employeeId'. We try to keep title optional.
- IP allowlist: Our security team requires two CIDR ranges for inbound webhooks: 34.120.16.0/20 and 34.121.0.0/18. Outbound egress from our side is unrestricted for callbacks but we have an allowlist for admin console access — see note in CSV.
- Service accounts: Peregrine policy prefers dedicated per-environment accounts for auditability (prod / staging / dev). Naming convention: pf-redwood-{env}-sa.
- Org policies: We block group creation via SCIM unless created by admin; provisioning should create memberships only, not new groups.

We’re available for a preflight on Monday 6/4 between 10–12 PT or 15–17 PT. If that works, send an invite.

Attachments:
- peregrine-scim-map.csv (text/csv)
- peregrine-sso-entity-ids.pdf (application/pdf)

-Martin Hall
IT Integration Lead
Peregrine Financial
martin.hall@peregrinefin.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Peregrine preflight checklist + ENG asks

Ben / Dylan —

I pulled Martin's notes and attachments from the thread. Quick internal preflight checklist for our 60-min alignment and owners:

1) SSO handshake (Ben)
   - Verify Okta metadata ingestion path (metadata URL vs XML). Bring test SP metadata.
   - Confirm NameID format and assertion encryption expectations.
2) SCIM mappings (Ben + Dylan)
   - Review attached CSV, confirm we support managerEmail -> manager mapping and employeeId -> external_id. Note: confirm if title being optional needs a fallback.
3) IP allowlist (EngOps - Ben)
   - Confirm our webhook egress IPs include the two CIDRs Martin listed. If not, produce list and ETA to add.
4) Service accounts (Dylan)
   - Agree on naming convention pf-redwood-{env}-sa; confirm minimum scopes required for provisioning and logs retention policy.
5) Org policy constraints (Monica)
   - Document that Peregrine blocks SCIM group creation; ensure our flow treats missing groups as errors in dry-run and surfaces to CS.

Deliverables before preflight:
- Ben: SP test metadata + quick runbook for SAML assertions (by Mon 10:00 PT).
- Dylan: Draft implementation MP (mutual plan) with rollback steps and cutover window request (Mon 12:00 PT).
- Monica: Draft passwordless and admin console access notes for Peregrine security (Mon 12:00 PT).

Propose we take Martin's suggested slot Monday 6/4 10:30 PT. Tentative invite to follow once Ben confirms test metadata availability. If any of the above items are blocked, flag here.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

All —

I can make the 6/4 10:30 PT slot. I’ve attached the SP test metadata (redwood-sp-peregrine-test.xml) and a short SAML assertion checklist. Quick notes after scanning Martin’s attachments:

- Okta metadata PDF looks standard; we prefer the metadata URL if they can generate it.
- SCIM mapping: we support managerEmail -> manager but need to confirm how they reference managers (email vs employeeId). I'll run a dry-provision against the CSV in staging and report back Monday AM.
- IP allowlist: our public webhook ranges currently include 34.120.16.0/20 but not 34.121.0.0/18. EngOps will have a change request to add the latter; ETA Tuesday EOD unless we use a secondary fallback.
- Service accounts: pf-redwood-prod-sa / pf-redwood-staging-sa are fine; will include minimum scopes list in the runbook.

Attachments in this message:
- redwood-sp-peregrine-test.xml (application/xml)
- saml-assertion-checklist.md (text/markdown)

I’ll post the dry-run results to the shared Drive link and update the invite when Monica confirms.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
